findings.quote: What makes the difference is our ability to harness the reins of progress and to combine progress with an ethic that is essential in that great leap that will undoubtedly change the world.
findings.rationale: The paragraph explicitly discusses AI disruption and calls for ethical direction of technological progress.

findings.quote: We must support those recommendations and move forward with that common effort so as to ensure that decisions about artificial intelligence are not left in the hands of a few and that its development is carried out in an ethical and responsible manner for the benefit of all humankind.
findings.rationale: Supports the UN advisory recommendations and inclusive, ethical AI governance.
